fusions.name: Thousand Fine Cuts
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snarl Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile tangle of strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bristling Hide
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 25% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Snagged Filaments
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
